questions.title: Array Echo Space Separated Drill
questions.description:
Read an integer N followed by N integers, store them in an array, and print them back on one line space-separated.

Input Format:
First line: integer N. Second line: N space-separated integers.

Output Format:
A single line containing N space-separated integers.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000, -1000000 <= arr[i] <= 1000000

questions.title: Array Forward Traversal Drill
questions.description:
Read an integer N followed by N integers and print each integer on its own line by traversing the array forward.

Input Format:
First line: integer N. Second line: N space-separated integers.

Output Format:
N lines, each containing one integer.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000, -1000000 <= arr[i] <= 1000000

questions.title: Array Sum Aggregation Drill
questions.description:
Read an integer N followed by N integers and print their sum.

Input Format:
First line: integer N. Second line: N space-separated integers.

Output Format:
Print the sum as a single integer on its own line.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000, -1000000 <= arr[i] <= 1000000

questions.title: Array Min and Max Drill
questions.description:
Read an integer N followed by N integers and print the minimum value on the first line and the maximum value on the second line.

Input Format:
First line: integer N. Second line: N space-separated integers.

Output Format:
Two lines: first the minimum, then the maximum.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000, -1000000 <= arr[i] <= 1000000

questions.title: Linear Search First Index Drill
questions.description:
Read an integer N, then N integers, then a target value. Print the 0-based index of the first occurrence of the target, or -1 if not found.

Input Format:
First line: integer N. Second line: N space-separated integers. Third line: target integer.

Output Format:
A single integer index, or -1.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000, -1000000 <= arr[i] <= 1000000

questions.title: Array Reversal Print Drill
questions.description:
Read an integer N followed by N integers and print them in reverse order, space-separated, on a single line.

Input Format:
First line: integer N. Second line: N space-separated integers.

Output Format:
A single line containing N space-separated integers in reverse order.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000, -1000000 <= arr[i] <= 1000000

questions.title: Classroom Marks Entry Reporter
questions.description:
A teacher enters the marks of all students in a class. The system stores them in an array and prints them back prefixed with "Class marks:" so the teacher can verify the entry.

Input Format:
First line: integer N (number of students). Second line: N space-separated integer marks.

Output Format:
A single line starting with "Class marks:" followed by the marks space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000, 0 <= mark <= 100

questions.title: Sensor Reading Sum and Average
questions.description:
A weather station records N temperature readings. Compute and print the total sum on the first line and the average on the second line (two decimal places).

Input Format:
First line: integer N. Second line: N space-separated integer readings.

Output Format:
Two lines: first the sum (integer), then the average (2 decimal places).

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000, -1000 <= reading <= 1000

questions.title: Inventory Stock Code Lookup
questions.description:
A warehouse stores N product codes in an array. A clerk searches for a target code; print 1 if it is present, 0 otherwise.

Input Format:
First line: integer N. Second line: N space-separated integer product codes. Third line: target code.

Output Format:
A single integer 1 (found) or 0 (not found).

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000, 1 <= code <= 1000000

questions.title: Customer Queue Reverse Service
questions.description:
A service counter serves customers in the reverse order of arrival. Read the queue of customer IDs and print "Serving: ID" for each customer in reverse order, one per line.

Input Format:
First line: integer N. Second line: N space-separated integer customer IDs.

Output Format:
N lines, each of the form "Serving: ID" in reverse arrival order.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000, 1 <= id <= 1000000

questions.title: Bank Running Balance Reporter
questions.description:
A bank records N transactions where positive values are deposits and negative values are withdrawals. Traverse the transaction array and print the running balance after each transaction, one balance per line.

Input Format:
First line: integer N. Second line: N space-separated integer transactions.

Output Format:
N lines, each containing the running balance after that transaction.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000, -1000000 <= transaction <= 1000000, final balance fits in a 64-bit signed integer

questions.title: Library Duplicate Book Finder
questions.description:
A library shelf may contain duplicate copies of the same book ID. The librarian searches for a target ID and prints every 0-based index at which it occurs, space-separated on one line. If no copies exist, print -1.

Input Format:
First line: integer N. Second line: N space-separated integer book IDs. Third line: target ID.

Output Format:
A single line with indices space-separated, or -1 if none.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000, 1 <= id <= 1000000

questions.title: Student Marks Second Highest
questions.description:
A teacher wants to find the second highest mark in a class where all marks are distinct. Do not sort the array; traverse it once to find both the highest and second highest values.

Input Format:
First line: integer N. Second line: N space-separated distinct integer marks.

Output Format:
Print the second highest mark on its own line.

Constraints:
2 <= N <= 1000, 0 <= mark <= 100, all marks distinct

questions.title: Game Score Left Rotation K Steps
questions.description:
A game records N player scores in order. The scoreboard must be left-rotated by K positions (the first K scores move to the end). Print the rotated scores space-separated. Do not use memcpy or memmove.

Input Format:
First line: integers N and K. Second line: N space-separated integers.

Output Format:
A single line with the rotated scores space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000, 0 <= K <= 1000000, -1000000 <= score <= 1000000

questions.title: Temperature Series In-Place Reversal
questions.description:
A meteorologist stores N daily temperature readings in an array and wants them reversed in-place using a two-pointer swap (no extra array, no memcpy/memmove). Print the reversed array space-separated.

Input Format:
First line: integer N. Second line: N space-separated integer temperatures.

Output Format:
A single line with the temperatures in reverse order, space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000, -1000 <= temperature <= 1000

questions.title: Bounded Frequency Counter
questions.description:
A survey collects N integer responses, each guaranteed to be in the range [1, K]. Count how many times each value 1..K appears. Initialize a frequency array, then print K lines, line i containing the count of value i.

Input Format:
First line: integers N and K. Second line: N space-separated integers each in [1, K].

Output Format:
K lines, each containing the frequency of value i (for i from 1 to K).

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000, 1 <= K <= 1000, each response in [1, K]
questions.inputconstrains: 1 <= N <= 1000, 1 <= K <= 1000, each response in [1, K]

questions.title: Stock Single Transaction Max Profit
questions.description:
A trader is given N daily stock prices and may make exactly one buy followed by one later sell. Compute the maximum achievable profit (sell price minus buy price). If no profit is possible, output 0. Traverse the array once tracking the minimum price seen so far.

Input Format:
First line: integer N. Second line: N space-separated integer prices.

Output Format:
A single integer: the maximum profit.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 10000, 1 <= price <= 1000000

questions.title: Array Right Rotation Reversal Trick
questions.description:
A log archiver right-rotates an array of N entries by K positions using the three-reversal trick: reverse the whole array, reverse the first K elements, then reverse the remaining N-K elements. Do not use memcpy or memmove. Print the rotated array space-separated.

Input Format:
First line: integers N and K. Second line: N space-separated integers.

Output Format:
A single line with the right-rotated array, space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000, 0 <= K <= 1000000, -1000000 <= value <= 1000000

questions.title: Sorted Catalog Distinct Element Counter
questions.description:
A product catalog stores N product codes in non-decreasing order. Traverse the sorted array once to count the number of distinct codes (do not sort or binary-search).

Input Format:
First line: integer N. Second line: N space-separated non-decreasing integers.

Output Format:
A single integer: the count of distinct elements.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000, -1000000 <= code <= 1000000

questions.title: Prefix Sum Range Query Processor
questions.description:
A data analyst precomputes prefix sums of an array of N integers to answer Q range-sum queries fast. For each query (l r) with 0-based inclusive indices, print the sum of arr[l..r] using prefix[r+1] - prefix[l]. Do not sort the array.

Input Format:
First line: integer N. Second line: N space-separated integers. Third line: integer Q. Next Q lines: two space-separated integers l and r.

Output Format:
Q lines, each the sum of arr[l..r].

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000, 1 <= Q <= 1000, 0 <= l <= r < N, -1000000 <= arr[i] <= 1000000
